app_application: A student's Application for one Term: chosen Room Type and Room Class, price and Deposit fixed at submission, roommate mode, Gia hạn (stay_terms), status from Awaiting Deposit to Allocated, Forfeited, Rejected, Expired or Cancelled.
app_application_event: History of an Application (status changes and notes) shown on the student's Application page.
app_roommate_check: Rate limit for roommate code checks (privacy: the same answer for every unusable code, limited attempts).
app_roommate_invitation: Invitation of a 2-bed roommate by student code: pending, accepted, declined or expired within roommate_hours.
app_round2_offer: Round-2 offer to a Waitlisted Application: up to three held Beds, accepted or declined before it expires.
app_round2_option: One held Bed (Room Type, Room Class, Block, price difference) of a Round-2 offer.
asg_allocation: A student's Bed in a Term: from the assignment, a Round-2 offer, a renewal (next-Term Allocation) or a move. Status Active, Ended or Cancelled; resident_at and code_released_at mark residence; renewal = Awaiting extension or Continuing.
asg_check_out: Check-out at the desk: meter readings, key, condition, damage charge, Utility Deposit settlement and refund.
asg_check_out_damage: Damage recorded per furniture item at a check-out (amount and note).
asg_late_check_in: Late check-in asked online or recorded at the desk: requested date, evidence, decision and the new Balance deadline.
asg_move: Operational move between Beds (or Rooms) by Staff or a Manager, with reason, meter cut and no price difference.
asg_proposal_item: One proposed placement of an assignment run: Application, Bed, fit score, conflict code and resolution.
asg_renewal: The requests window of a Term (M2 to M7): when it opened, closed filing, alerted Managers, issued and closed next-Term fees.
asg_run: An assignment run of a Term (dry run or real): matching snapshot used, counts, average fit and status.
asg_run_block: Per-Block review state of a real run: submitted, approved or returned, committed.
asg_stay: A student's continuous stay: Terms committed (Gia hạn, grown by extensions) and used, Active or Ended.
asg_termination: Termination of a stay (Utility debt, discipline, not enrolled): notice sent, move-out date, overdue, checked out or cancelled.
auth_action_token: One-time tokens (hashed) for password reset and account invitation links.
auth_reconciliation: An enrollment reconciliation run of a Term: the uploaded enrolled list or leavers list.
auth_reconciliation_item: One difference found by a reconciliation (groups 1-4) with its resolution and note.
auth_session: Sign-in sessions (hashed bearer token, method, expiry, revocation).
auth_staff_account_request: A Manager's request to create a Staff account for a Block.
auth_staff_profile: Staff handles (request types they take) and on-duty flag, used by routing and workload.
auth_student: Student directory record: student code, gender, major, cohort, region, enrollment status, priority groups, contact and verification state.
auth_student_import: A student list import (CSV or XLSX): preview counts and the applied result.
auth_student_import_row: One line of a student list import with its outcome (new, updated, unchanged, error).
auth_user: Every account (student, Staff, Manager, Admin): email, password hash or Google subject, role, status, lock, locale, demo flag.
auth_user_block: Blocks a Staff account works for (Block scope).
bil_bank_transaction_archive: Archive of bank transactions received from SePay before payment claims replaced it (read only since v2 phase 5).
bil_invoice: An Invoice: Deposit, Balance (with the Utility Deposit), next-Term fee, Utility, charge or credit; amount fixed once issued; status Unpaid, Awaiting confirmation, Paid, Overdue, Void or Refunded.
bil_meter_cut: Meter values recorded when a resident leaves or moves mid-period, to split Utility by time.
bil_meter_period: A monthly meter-reading period of a Block (open, then closed when readings are confirmed and Utility Invoices issued).
bil_meter_reading: Electricity and water readings of one Room in a period (missing, entered, check value, confirmed).
bil_payment: A confirmed payment of an Invoice (method, reference, receipt file, who confirmed it, its claim).
bil_payment_claim: A student's 'I have transferred' claim: stops the Invoice's clock; confirmed or rejected by a Manager.
bil_refund: A refund to decide or pay (Deposit, Balance, check-out, termination) with the rule and the amount.
bil_utility_warning: Utility debt warnings (first, final with termination date) of an Allocation and how they closed.
cfg_block_settings: Per-Block desk hours, visiting hours, quiet hours and house rules (within the Admin limits).
cfg_eligibility_criterion: Eligibility checks the Admin switches on or off (e.g. enrolled, verified, no debt).
cfg_fee_policy: Default Deposit percentage, Deposit window and Balance days for new Terms.
cfg_lookup: Option lists (majors, regions, out-of-service reasons, request categories...).
cfg_matching_snapshot: Versioned roommate-matching settings (hard constraints, criteria order, weights) used by assignment runs.
cfg_parameter: System parameters (limits, windows, timers) grouped by settings page.
cfg_priority_group: Priority groups (first year, far from campus, scholarship, policy beneficiary) and whether they apply.
cfg_refund_rule: Refund rules per trigger: percentage and approver role.
cfg_room_class: Room Classes (Basic, Standard, Premium): surcharge rate and amenities.
cfg_room_type: Room Types (2, 4, 6, 8 Beds): base price per Bed and roommate selection rule.
cfg_term: A Term (FA26, SP27...): stay dates, registration milestones, renewal milestones M1-M7, Deposit and Utility Deposit fixed at publication, rules.
cfg_term_price: The Term's price per Bed for each Room Type and Room Class, fixed when the Term is published.
cfg_term_request: A Manager's registration-period request to the Admin (dates, Blocks, Rooms left out, places, prices); status Submitted to Done.
cfg_term_request_event: History and comments of a registration-period request.
cfg_term_room_excluded: Rooms a Term leaves out of the assignment and Round 2.
cfg_utility_policy: Utility prices per kWh and m3, reading day, payment days, rounding, reminders and the Utility Deposit estimate.
inv_bed: A Bed of a Room (label A, B...), in service or not.
inv_building: A Block (Building): code, name, gender, status.
inv_door_code: Door codes of a Room, stored encrypted: proposed, active (confirmed on the lock) or retired.
inv_door_code_task: A door code to change after someone left the Room.
inv_floor: A Floor of a Block with the Room Class new Rooms start with.
inv_floor_layout: How many Rooms of each Room Type a Floor has (used to generate Rooms).
inv_furniture_event: History of a furniture item (status changes, repairs, damage, moves).
inv_furniture_item: A furniture item with its asset code, type, status and place (a Room or a Block store).
inv_furniture_move: A move of a furniture item between Rooms and stores.
inv_furniture_type: Furniture types (bed, wardrobe, desk, air conditioner, fridge...) and whether they define a Room Class.
inv_room: A Room: code, Block, Floor, Room Type, the Room Class it was built with, out-of-service state.
inv_room_class_requirement: Furniture a Room Class requires (type and quantity).
inv_room_class_term: A Room's Room Class from a given Term on.
mnt_checklist_item: One item of an inspection checklist (category, severity).
mnt_inspection_result: The answer to a checklist item for one Room of an inspection run.
mnt_inspection_room: One Room of an inspection run and its state.
mnt_inspection_room_check: The Room's own checks of an inspection (number of people, each required furniture item).
mnt_inspection_run: An inspection run of a Block on a date by an inspector.
mnt_inspection_schedule: A recurring inspection schedule of a Block (scope, floors, repeat, assignee).
mnt_request: A Maintenance Request: Room, reporter, category, urgency, furniture item, assignee, SLA deadline, status Submitted to Closed.
mnt_request_event: History and messages of a Maintenance Request.
mnt_request_photo: Photos attached to a Maintenance Request.
ntf_announcement: Announcements of the dormitory board (Term published, price changes, operations), in English and Vietnamese.
ntf_announcement_block: Blocks an announcement is shown to.
ntf_email_campaign: Emails the Admin sends to a group of students.
ntf_email_outbox: Outgoing emails (queued, sent, failed) dispatched every 30 seconds.
ntf_notification: In-app notifications of a user (read state).
ntf_template: Notification texts per event (push, in-app; English and Vietnamese).
req_escalation: An escalation opened by the SLA scan (overdue or unassigned request) and how it was handled.
req_room_change: A next-Term room change request (same Block, other Block or Room Class) with its decision and target Bed.
req_room_class_change: A request to change a Room's Room Class from the next Term, with every continuing resident's consent and the furniture check.
req_room_class_consent: One continuing resident's answer to a Room Class change.
req_routing_rule: Rules that assign requests of a Block to Staff by type and condition.
req_sla_policy: Per-Block time limits: urgent and normal maintenance, room changes.
req_stay_request: Extension (more Terms) or end-of-stay request for the next Term.
req_swap: A swap of two residents' next-Term Beds (direct or from the swap board) with both agreements and Staff's decision.
req_swap_post: A swap board post: what Bed a resident wants in exchange.
shared_audit_log: Audit Log of every configuration change, irreversible action, export and door-code view.
shared_file: Uploaded files (photos, receipts, evidence) stored on the server volume and served through signed links.
